object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Start mellon-mcp over stdio on a clone, with --repo-root given relative to the working directory, under each log level. Expected: under DEBUG and INFO, standard error holds the clone's resolved absolute path, and a test checks that the path is absolute. Under WARNING and ERROR it doesn't. Probe: the line is 'mellon-mcp serving <absolute path> (3 document(s))'.
